key_insight: FusionRare combines complementary AI approaches and reports macro-averaged Recall@1 of 51% using phenotypes alone and 79% using phenotypes plus genotypes for rare-disease prioritization.
clinical_relevance: In a clinician-AI study, FusionRare improved the true diagnosis’s rank in 45% of decisions, increased physician confidence in 62%, and reduced time to diagnosis by 21%.
method: Combines symbolic reasoning, deep-learning pattern recognition, patient-case retrieval, and LLM inference.
Integrates outputs through statistical meta-aggregation and knowledge-enhanced agentic reflection.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluation on 2,528 strictly isolated clinical cases under anti-leakage protocols, plus randomized crossover clinician-AI validation.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish prospective real-world diagnostic accuracy or patient outcomes; broader clinical validation remains important.
paper_title: Unified Multiparadigm Fusion Intelligence for Rare Disease Diagnosis
